case.summary: Case HHG-001 was initiated for customer C12382 regarding card C12382-K1 after transaction 3514030 for $77.07 on 2016-12-04 19:55:28 was flagged for out-of-region use in billing region 444. Region 444 accounts for only 2.8% of the card's historical activity, and home activity continued in parallel. When contacted, the customer stated they did not make the purchase and still hold the card. Based on a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92 and the customer's confirmation, the verdict is confirmed fraud with $77.07 in exposure.
